title: Salvation by Grace Alone
definition: Salvation by Grace Alone teaches that sinners are saved by God's unearned favor, not by human works, worthiness, or achievement.
summary: Grace is the source of salvation from beginning to end.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the gift of God, and through Him salvation is received as mercy rather than wages.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Salvation by Grace Alone helps explain how God saves sinners through Jesus Christ rather than through human merit, religious performance, or self-rescue. This doctrine shows that salvation is personal, covenantal, and centered on the finished work of Christ.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can understand the grace they have received and proclaim the Gospel with clarity. It guards the Church from confusion by keeping sin, grace, faith, repentance, righteousness, forgiveness, and eternal hope in their biblical order.

The heart of this doctrine is grace is the source of salvation from beginning to end.. It should lead to worship, assurance, humility, holiness, and a deeper confidence in the Savior who saves completely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people easily drift toward either despair or self-righteousness. Salvation by Grace Alone reminds believers that salvation belongs to the Lord, rests in Christ, and produces real transformation without turning grace into license or obedience into a way to earn acceptance with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility and examine whether your hope is resting in Christ. Let salvation by grace alone shape your prayers, your witness, your repentance, and your daily confidence that Jesus is able to save and keep all who come to God through Him.
